# spo_site_script (Data Source)

Look up an existing SiteScript object. Set identity to select it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identity` (String) Identity used to look up the object.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String) The site script JSON (the actions document).
- `description` (String) The site script description.
- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
- `title` (String) The site script display name.
